name: midnight
prompt: Create a simple cozy watercolor activity card for the peaceful South-of-Tethys game, ancient South Asia. Wide landscape 4:3, intended native 512x384 pixels. Gentle watercolor washes and a few fine warm ink lines, broad uncluttered shapes, warm paper, varied muted indigo, sage green, ochre, soft plum and cream, no sepia filter, no photorealism, no pixel art, no dramatic comic hatching, no lettering, frame, collage, watermark or UI. Use image 1 only for Mirlepa's identity and Kalash-inspired woven cap/clothing; image 2 only for Yamantaka's identity, three heads and cream-scarf/indigo woven highland clothing; image 3 only for the green northeastern cave setting, prayer flags, tiny fire and terracotta basket-insulated Icmic cooker. Render all people in the same soft cozy watercolor style rather than anime. EXACTLY THREE adult people and THREE bodies: one friendly brown-skinned South Asian woman traveller with dark braid, plain light indigo cotton wrap and cream shawl; Mirlepa, fair light-beige Tibetan-inspired Denisovan man, robust brow, dark beard and cap, one head; Yamantaka, fair Tibetan-inspired Denisovan man with exactly THREE PHYSICAL HEADS on his ONE broad body, central head forward and two side heads naturally attached at the shoulders, distinct readable faces, dark shoulder-length hair. Total FIVE heads across THREE people. Yamantaka is broad and about twice Mirlepa's seated bulk. Calm friendly human expressions. Keep all three people and every head fully inside the central 75% of the picture with ample crop room, important faces away from top/bottom edges. No additional guests. Scene: sheltered inside the broad rock cave at nightfall, green mountain stream and distant cool hills visible beyond the cave opening. All THREE friends sit comfortably together on woven mats around one tiny low cookfire, enjoying warm bowls and a relaxed shared meal; Mirlepa sits left, traveller middle, large three-headed Yamantaka right. Show their gentle smiles and a feeling of companionship. Three separate rolled quilts and cushions lie ready nearby for sleeping. Small basket-insulated clay cooker and one kettle, a few prayer flags outside. Warm amber firelight against soft blue dusk. No other bodies or faces.
